instruction: Set the display name for the email account to 'John Doe' in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully removed the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account by right-clicking the account, opening Settings, using Account Actions > Remove Account, and confirming the removal dialog. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird UI, use right-click context menus, open Account Settings, interact with Account Actions dropdown, handle confirmation dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Tests account identity editing rather than account removal. Uses the same Account Settings navigation the model demonstrated, but requires modifying identity fields instead of deleting the account.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the display name (Your Name field) in Account Settings from 'Anonym Tester' to 'John Doe'. Evaluator closes Thunderbird to flush prefs.js, then reads the prefs.js file to verify mail.identity.id1.fullName equals 'John Doe'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads mail.identity.id1.fullName from Thunderbird's prefs.js, which is the correct preference key for the display name (Your Name field)
Regex pattern correctly parses Thunderbird's user_pref format to extract the string value
Postconfig correctly kills Thunderbird and waits 3 seconds to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before reading
Metric correctly handles type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_value') without wrapping in rules
Exact string comparison with strip() is appropriate for verifying the display name matches 'John Doe'
Single instruction requirement (set display name to 'John Doe') is fully covered by the evaluator
Edge cases handled: missing file returns error, missing pref key returns None which yields 0.0 score
